user_query: I'm a journalist working on an article about the latest technology trends. Can you recommend some popular tech blogs or news websites that cover a wide range of technology topics? It would be helpful to retrieve the articles from these sources along with their authors, publication dates, and full-text content.

TaskList.description: Research and compile a list of popular tech blogs and news websites that cover technology trends.
Query the selected tech blogs and news websites for articles related to the latest technology trends.
Extract article information such as authors, publication dates, and full-text content from the retrieved articles.
